source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: At Singles events, attendees can showcase their hobby skills, aim for Best General, make connections or explore unusual rules interactions. Check the Rules Appendix when the Core Rules leave a question open. Warhammer 40,000 app users can find it there. The relevant faction’s errata and FAQ can also resolve edge cases.

fields.trigger: unclear interaction under the Core Rules
consult: Rules Appendix in the Warhammer 40,000 app
